chapter.title: Night of the Soul
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the two PowerPyx 100% charts (58 nodes: 41 Markus, 17 Connor) and the game’s text (the two detroitbecometext templates resolved against the string table). Markus: PAY RESPECTS (checkpoint, Carl died in Broken) → CONFIDE IN CARL at the grave (four rounds), or WELCOME HOME (checkpoint) → ENTER THE HOUSE → [EXPLORE THE HOUSE: PLAY PIANO, BROWSE BOOKS, LOOK AT THE CHESSBOARD (each needs The Painter’s pastime), LISTEN TO LEO’S MESSAGE, LOOK AT YOUR PAINTING] → GO UPSTAIRS → CARL’S NURSE INTERVENES → CONVERT CARL’S NURSE → ENTER BEDROOM → RECONCILE WITH CARL → CONFIDE IN CARL (or CARL DIES after ANGER twice) → LEAVE. Then MARKUS AMONG THE PEOPLE (no raid) or MARKUS ON SACRED GROUND → DEVIANTS REGROUP → [TALK TO NORTH (+ SHARE A MOMENT WITH NORTH), TALK TO KARA, TALK TO JOSH, TALK TO SIMON, TALK TO CONNOR → KILL CONNOR (A NEW CONNOR WILL BE SENT) / SPARE CONNOR] → VIOLENT ATTACK / PEACEFUL PROTEST → MARKUS CHOSE TO FIGHT / TO PROTEST FOR HIS PEOPLE. With Markus gone: NORTH AMONG THE PEOPLE or NORTH ON SACRED GROUND → (DEVIANTS REGROUP) → CALL TO ARMS → NORTH DECIDED TO ATTACK THE CAMP. Connor: THIN ICE → THE LAST ASSIGNMENT (Connor died in Crossroads); HANK’S HOUSE → ENTER HOUSE → TALK TO HANK → HANK CONFIDES ABOUT HIS SON / HANK RAILS AGAINST ANDROIDS → LEAVE → HANK COMMITTED SUICIDE (Hank quit the force); CONNOR ON SACRED GROUND → DEVIANTS REGROUP → [TALK TO NORTH, TALK TO KARA, CHECK ON JOSH, CHECK ON SIMON] → NORTH CALLS TO ARMS → NORTH DECIDED TO ATTACK THE CAMP. Eleven template arrows, all on Markus’s talks, TRUST and the speech; no probability, timer, public-opinion or instability change. Researched in docs/research/ch31-night-of-the-soul.md.

decisions.title: Pay Respects: Confide in Carl at his grave
decisions.context: Carl died in Broken. Markus speaks to his gravestone in four rounds; nobody answers.

options.label: HEARTFUL / MOURNFUL / REGRETFUL / REFLECTIVE
options.effect: Lines only.

options.label: DEPRESSED / DOUBTFUL / PESSIMISTIC / CONFLICTED
options.effect: Lines only.

options.label: ADVICE / BIG DECISION / ANGRY
options.effect: Lines only; ANGRY has no effect here.

options.label: DESPAIRING / EMOTIONAL / LOST
options.effect: Markus leaves and passes Leo, who stares at him.

decisions.gate: Markus alive and leading; Carl died in Broken.
decisions.note: Chart nodes PAY RESPECTS (checkpoint) and CONFIDE IN CARL; the four rounds are the template’s. Leo on the path is wiki prose, not a chart node.

benchmark.note: An event and four no-effect decision rounds with the template’s buttons; `ch31CarlFate` = grave.

decisions.title: Welcome Home: explore Carl’s house
decisions.context: Carl survived Broken. The house lets Markus in (“Welcome home, Markus.”); he can look around before going up.

options.label: PLAY PIANO / BROWSE BOOKS / LOOK AT THE CHESSBOARD
options.effect: Each only if Markus chose that pastime in The Painter.

options.label: LISTEN TO LEO’S MESSAGE
options.effect: Leo apologises and says he is proud to be Carl’s son.

options.label: LOOK AT YOUR PAINTING
options.effect: The painting from The Painter is in the studio.

options.label: GO UPSTAIRS
options.effect: Moves on to the caretaker and Carl.

decisions.gate: Markus alive and leading; Carl alive after Broken.
decisions.note: Chart nodes WELCOME HOME (checkpoint), ENTER THE HOUSE, the [EXPLORE THE HOUSE] bracket and GO UPSTAIRS.

benchmark.note: An event, then a repeatable scene (each action once; GO UPSTAIRS leaves). The pastimes read `painterActivity` from The Painter. No stat change.

decisions.title: Confide in Carl at his bedside
decisions.context: Markus converts Carl’s caretaker, sits with Carl and answers “What’s wrong, Markus?” in two or three rounds.

options.label: ADVICE or DECISION
options.effect: Carl’s advice: “Face the abyss… but don’t let it consume you.” Carl lives.

options.label: ANGER, then REASON
options.effect: Carl gives his blessing and lives.

options.label: ANGER, then ANGER
options.effect: “Be careful… you don’t become a monster yourself.” CARL DIES.

decisions.note: Chart nodes CARL’S NURSE INTERVENES, CONVERT CARL’S NURSE, ENTER BEDROOM, RECONCILE WITH CARL, CONFIDE IN CARL, CARL DIES and LEAVE.

benchmark.note: Two events, the bedside rounds (RESIGNED / FATALISTIC / LOST / GRIM; ADVICE / DECISION / ANGER; REASON / ANGER after ANGER), CARL DIES (event, sets `carl` false) and LEAVE. `ch31CarlFate` = confided or died. No stat change.

decisions.title: Deviants Regroup: the talks in the church
decisions.context: After the raid the survivors regroup in a church. Markus can talk to North, Kara, Josh, Simon and Connor before he speaks.

options.label: TALK TO NORTH
options.effect: North small up; SITUATION / SURVIVORS / WOUND / CAMPS, “I love you, Markus…” at Lover (SHARE A MOMENT WITH NORTH); if Markus was cast out and returned, her apology and HUMBLE (North small up) / FORGIVING / RESENTFUL.

options.label: TALK TO KARA
options.effect: Kara and Alice are leaving for the last bus.

options.label: TALK TO JOSH
options.effect: Josh small up.

options.label: TALK TO SIMON
options.effect: Simon small up; with North dead, SITUATION / NORTH / HOW MANY / CAMPS / JOSH.

options.label: TALK TO CONNOR
options.effect: Decide whether Connor is trustworthy.

decisions.gate: Markus leads and Jericho was attacked in Crossroads.
decisions.note: Chart nodes MARKUS ON SACRED GROUND, DEVIANTS REGROUP and the bracket’s talks. All optional, any order.

benchmark.note: An event, then a repeatable scene whose talks with their own prompt continue inside it; TALK TO CONNOR goes to M26. Arrows from the template only.

decisions.title: Talk to Connor: trust or don’t trust?
decisions.context: Connor: “It’s my fault the humans managed to locate Jericho… I can understand if you decide not to trust me…”

options.label: TRUST (chart: SPARE CONNOR)
options.effect: Jericho small up. Connor reveals his plan to wake the androids at the CyberLife plant and goes to the tower.

options.label: DON’T TRUST (chart: KILL CONNOR)
options.effect: Markus shoots him; A NEW CONNOR WILL BE SENT. No stat change in the template (the wiki lists a Jericho small down).

decisions.gate: Markus leads, the raid happened, and a deviant Connor survived it.
decisions.note: The game’s buttons are TRUST / DON’T TRUST; the plan is revealed only after TRUST.

benchmark.note: The interrupt scene of DEVIANTS REGROUP. TRUST sets `ch31ConnorFate` spared; DON’T TRUST kills Connor (no longer deviant, replaced) with no stat change and sets `ch31ConnorFate` killed.

decisions.title: Demonstration or revolution?
decisions.context: Markus: “Humans have decided to exterminate us… Time has come to make a choice, one that very well may determine the future of our people.”

options.label: DEMONSTRATION (chart: PEACEFUL PROTEST)
options.effect: Josh small up, North small down, Jericho large up. MARKUS CHOSE TO PROTEST FOR HIS PEOPLE.

options.label: REVOLUTION (chart: VIOLENT ATTACK)
options.effect: North small up, Josh small down, Jericho large up. MARKUS CHOSE TO FIGHT FOR HIS PEOPLE.

decisions.gate: Markus leads (in Jericho’s hold without a raid, in the church after one). No public-opinion or relationship requirement.
decisions.note: Chart nodes MARKUS AMONG THE PEOPLE (no raid) and the VIOLENT ATTACK / PEACEFUL PROTEST pair under both Markus starts.

benchmark.note: Sets `movement` and `ch31MarkusEnding`; REVOLUTION keeps `markusOutcome` liberated for Battle for Detroit.

decisions.title: North leads: Call to Arms
decisions.context: Markus is dead or was cast out and left. North addresses the androids: “They wanted a war… they’ll get it.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: NORTH DECIDED TO ATTACK THE CAMP; an armed uprising.

decisions.gate: Markus gone and North alive; no deviant Connor in the church.
decisions.note: Chart nodes NORTH AMONG THE PEOPLE, NORTH ON SACRED GROUND, DEVIANTS REGROUP, CALL TO ARMS and the ending NORTH DECIDED TO ATTACK THE CAMP.

benchmark.note: Observer events (no protagonist is there); sets `movement` revolution and `ch31MarkusEnding`.

decisions.title: Thin Ice: the last assignment
decisions.context: Amanda to a replacement Connor: “The previous Connor failed its mission. You’re going to replace it.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: The replacement sets out to destroy the deviant leader.

decisions.note: Chart nodes THIN ICE (checkpoint) and THE LAST ASSIGNMENT; the wiki counts it as Connor’s sixth outcome.

benchmark.note: One event; sets `ch31ThinIce` and `ch31ConnorEnding` Thin Ice (the wiki counts this checkpoint as an ending; a later ending replaces it). No Zen Garden scene for a deviant Connor and no deactivation in this chapter.

decisions.title: Hank’s House
decisions.context: Hank quit the force. Connor finds him at his kitchen table with his revolver and Cole’s photo, and talks to him in three rounds.

options.label: GOODBYE / APOLOGIZE / WORRIED ABOUT HANK / RECONCILE
options.effect: Lines only.

options.label: PHOTO (saw Cole’s photo in Russian Roulette) / GUN / ALCOHOL
options.effect: Then Hank confides about Cole (Connor died twice or more) or rails against androids (never died).

options.label: CONVINCE / DON’T INSIST
options.effect: “GET OUTTA HERE!” Connor leaves; HANK COMMITTED SUICIDE.

decisions.gate: Hank resigned in Last Chance, Connor (Hostile).
decisions.note: Chart nodes HANK’S HOUSE, ENTER HOUSE, TALK TO HANK, HANK CONFIDES ABOUT HIS SON, HANK RAILS AGAINST ANDROIDS, LEAVE and HANK COMMITTED SUICIDE. No answer saves Hank.

benchmark.note: Events and three no-effect rounds; Hank’s speech by `connorDeaths` (≥2 confides, 0 rails, 1 neither); sets `hank` false, `ch31HankEnding` and `ch31ConnorEnding`. Gated on `hankResigned` only.

decisions.title: Connor on Sacred Ground
decisions.context: A deviant Connor is in the church and Markus is gone; North leads. Connor can talk to North and Kara and check on Josh and Simon.

options.label: TALK TO NORTH
options.effect: MARKUS / SITUATION / SURVIVORS, then Connor proposes waking the androids at the CyberLife plant.

options.label: TALK TO KARA
options.effect: Only if Connor chased Kara on the highway in On the Run; he apologises.

options.label: CHECK ON JOSH / CHECK ON SIMON
options.effect: No lines.

options.label: NORTH CALLS TO ARMS
options.effect: NORTH DECIDED TO ATTACK THE CAMP.

decisions.gate: Connor deviant and alive in the church; Markus dead or cast out.
decisions.note: Chart nodes CONNOR ON SACRED GROUND, DEVIANTS REGROUP, the [EXPLORE THE CHURCH] bracket, NORTH CALLS TO ARMS and the ending. No arrows in Connor’s half.

benchmark.note: An event, a repeatable scene with North’s round inside it, and the call to arms; sets `movement` revolution and both charts’ endings.
